name: Teal Cartage
tagline: White-glove passage for the objects that matter most to one person at a time.
positioning: Teal Cartage moves single precious items — heirlooms, prototypes, handmade instruments — with a curated courier network and a manifest built for one.

hero.h1: Every parcel deserves a pilgrimage, not a pipeline.
hero.sub: Teal Cartage is the world's first courier network engineered for the single, irreplaceable object — the one you would never trust to a bulk carrier's conveyor belt.

features.title: The Manifest of One
features.description: A living dossier for your item — condition photos, provenance notes, handling rituals — that travels with every hand that touches it, from doorstep to doorstep.

features.title: Hand-picked couriers
features.description: No anonymous drivers. Each leg is assigned to a vetted specialist who signs for your object and stays reachable until it arrives.

features.title: Chain-of-custody clarity
features.description: Every transfer is timestamped, geo-pinned, and photographed. You watch your heirloom advance across the map, checkpoint by checkpoint.

features.title: Bespoke crating
features.description: Custom-cut foam, moisture control, and shock telemetry for fragile ceramics, vintage synths, and framed originals — measured to the millimeter.

features.title: Climate-honest routing
features.description: We plan around heat, humidity, and altitude, not just distance, so a lacquered guitar never sees a hot loading dock.

features.title: One human, always
features.description: A named concierge owns your shipment end to end. No queue, no ticket number — just the person who knows exactly where your thing is.

testimonials.quote: I sold a 1962 archtop to a collector three countries away. Teal Cartage crated it, tracked the humidity in transit, and sent me a photo of it resting in his studio. I have never exhaled like that.
testimonials.name: Marisol Devereux

testimonials.quote: Galleries treat a single canvas like freight. Teal Cartage treated it like the only object in the world. The Manifest of One is now a condition report my insurer actually trusts.
testimonials.name: Anders Kwon

testimonials.quote: My grandmother's porcelain crossed the Atlantic with a named courier and zero drama. Watching each checkpoint light up on the map felt less like shipping and more like an escort.
testimonials.name: Priya Ravensworth

pricing.blurb: For the one-off treasure that simply cannot go in a bin.
For makers and sellers who ship precious pieces every week.
For studios and collections moving irreplaceable inventory at pace.

homepage.footerBlurb: Teal Cartage carries the objects a spreadsheet can't measure — one irreplaceable thing, moved with the reverence it was made with.
